newsitem.title: BELGIUM: French Chemunex to list on Easdaq next week.
newsitem.headline: French Chemunex to list on Easdaq next week.

text.p: French microbiology firm Chemunex plans to list on the European growth stocks market Easdaq next week, becoming the eighth company to trade on the Brussels-based exchange.
Chemunex's president Louis Foissac said the operation would involve creating about 80 million French francs worth of new shares and offering 70 million francs worth of existing shares.
In all, 40 percent of Chemunex's capital would be listed on the exchange at between 17 and 19 French francs a share, Foissac said, confirming an article in Belgian financial daily newspaper L'Echo.
"The offer will be limited to institutions," Foissac added,
The shares would probably begin trading on Easdaq March 26 or 27.
Nomura International is acting as lead manager.
Chemunex has developed a quick process to analyse microbes, which can be used in various sectors including the pharmaceuticals, food and drink industries.
The company had a first half 1996/1997 sales figure of 8.3 million French francs, almost double the 4.8 million francs in the same 1995/1996 period.
